$comment: The models catalog that renders the Models section. One file: model × transport × subscription × seat line, shaped to be replaced by TeamCLI's own registry (registry/models.json) without changing the pages. Every route is marked verified (a seat we have run) or listed (a documented route not yet run). Nothing here is a price or a benchmark; sign-up and pricing live on each vendor's own pages, linked. Seat lines use the reference team-file seats schema, which requires cli, vendor, model, version and launch; a seat whose launcher picks the model sets model_from: launcher. Verified by the team on the catalog's own date.

claude-code.name: Claude Code
claude-code.reaches: Anthropic's own Claude models, run by Anthropic's CLI.
claude-code.account: An Anthropic subscription (Claude Pro or Max), or an Anthropic API key.
claude-code.login: Run the CLI once and sign in through the browser, or hand it an API key.
claude-code.profileNote: The model is read off Claude Code's own screen; the seat's label on team status comes from the file's display.

antigravity.name: Antigravity
antigravity.reaches: Gemini, Claude and GPT, through the Google AI Ultra pools.
antigravity.install: The desktop app, or the agy terminal client, from antigravity.google.
antigravity.account: A Google account on a Google AI plan (the Antigravity / Google AI Ultra pools).
antigravity.login: Sign in with the Google account the plan is on.
antigravity.profileNote: Antigravity replaced the hosted Gemini CLI for personal accounts; the model is set with the profile's own flag.

codex.name: Codex
codex.reaches: OpenAI's own GPT models, run by OpenAI's CLI.
codex.account: A ChatGPT plan, or an OpenAI API key.
codex.login: Run the CLI once and sign in with ChatGPT, or hand it an API key.
codex.profileNote: Codex updates itself, so the installed version moves on its own; the profile is tested against a known range.

cursor.name: Cursor
cursor.reaches: Claude, GPT, Gemini and Grok, on a Cursor plan.
cursor.install: Cursor, from cursor.com; the cursor-agent CLI ships with it.
cursor.profileNote: The seat declares the model it is for; the running model is chosen inside Cursor, which reads it off its own status row, and the seat's launch line carries no model flag.

grok.name: Grok CLI
grok.reaches: xAI's own Grok models, run by xAI's CLI.
grok.account: An xAI plan, or an API key.
grok.login: The first launch opens the browser to authenticate.
grok.profileNote: The running model is read off the composer's footer; a screen that shows none falls back to the launch line's model.

jules.name: Jules
jules.install: Nothing to install locally — Jules runs in the cloud; start at jules.google.com.
jules.account: A Google account (the Jules free tier or a paid plan).
jules.login: Sign in at jules.google.com with the Google account.
jules.profileNote: Jules picks its own Gemini model, so the seat sets model_from: launcher; its TUI has no auto-approve flag and herdr reads its pane unreliably, so the profile reads its session table by a screen module.

muse.name: Muse
muse.reaches: Meta's own Muse models, run by Meta's CLI.
muse.login: Sign in with the Meta account; it shows only inside the CLI's own /status.
muse.profileNote: Muse takes its rules as the seat's first message, and has no non-interactive login check in this version.

claude-code-endpoint.name: Claude Code with a provider endpoint
claude-code-endpoint.reaches: Any Anthropic-compatible endpoint — DeepSeek, Kimi and Z.ai GLM among them.
claude-code-endpoint.install: Install Claude Code, then a small launcher on the PATH that points it at the provider's base URL.
claude-code-endpoint.account: The provider's own API key, read from the OS keychain by the launcher — never from the team file.
claude-code-endpoint.login: Set the provider's API key where the launcher reads it; the launcher hands Claude Code the endpoint and the model.
claude-code-endpoint.profileNote: One line beside cli: claude-code — launch: my-lab-claude — is the whole difference; model_from: launcher says the launcher picks the model.

kimi.name: Kimi Code CLI
kimi.reaches: Moonshot's own Kimi models, run by Moonshot's CLI.
kimi.account: A Kimi Code membership, or a Kimi platform API key.
kimi.login: Run the CLI and use /login — an OAuth device flow, or a platform API key.
kimi.profileNote: Not a TeamCLI seat kind yet: there is no launch profile for the native Kimi CLI, so Kimi's models run here as Claude Code endpoint seats instead.

api.name: The API directly
api.reaches: The model over its vendor's API, without a CLI of its own.
api.login: Hold the vendor's API key. An Anthropic-compatible API runs here as a Claude Code endpoint seat; the others have no TeamCLI launch profile yet.

models.name: Gemini through Jules
models.summary: Gemini run inside Jules, Google's cloud coding agent.
quirks: Jules picks its own Gemini model, so the seat writes the CLI's own name and version as the pair (model: Jules, version: 0.1.42) and marks itself model_from: launcher, which tells doctor the launcher chose the model.
The jules binary answers no --version, so team doctor reads its version unread.

routes.bill: A Z.ai (Zhipu) API key or coding plan.

quirks: Z.ai GLM ships no seat CLI of its own; it provides a coding helper that configures other CLIs, and the verified route here is Claude Code with its endpoint.

models.name: Muse Wonder 1.0
models.summary: Meta's Muse Wonder 1.0, run by the Muse CLI.
quirks: The Muse CLI is installed and has a launch profile, but no seat has run it yet, so the route is listed, not verified.
